parallels.note: Ascribe to Yahweh the glory due to his name. Bring an offering, and come before him. Worship Yahweh in holy array.

translations.web: Ascribe to Yahweh the glory due to his name. Bring an offering, and come into his courts.
translations.bsb: Ascribe to the LORD the glory due His name; bring an offering and enter His courts.
translations.kjv: Give unto the LORD the glory due unto his name: bring an offering, and come into his courts.
translations.asv: Ascribe unto Jehovah the glory due unto his name: Bring an offering, and come into his courts.
